$comment: Licenses any dependency may carry: OSI-approved only (SPDX ids). An exception names one package and the exact license it was reviewed under; a change of license fails the check again.

@sentry/cli.reason: Sentry's CLI, used at build time by @sentry/nextjs for the web app only; never shipped in the library, the action or the service image.

sentry.reason: Sentry's CLI under its current package name (getsentry/cli), pulled in by @sentry/nextjs's bundler plugins in the same build-time role as @sentry/cli; never shipped.

caniuse-lite.reason: Browser-support data Next.js reads at build time for the web app; a data license, not code. Pending the maintainer's confirmation (T-825).
